agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is 2-body with large masses (17.1,14.8) and G=4.78, dt=0.0135. Bodies start 4.5 apart, body 1 falls toward body 0 and by step 31-32 distance shrinks from 0.42 to 0.10 (inside softening scale 0.3). Leapfrog with adaptive substeps (only 12-16 substeps at steps 30-32) is insufficient to resolve the steep softened potential gradient during this close encounter, causing huge kinetic/potential swing (KE ~1583 to 3517, PE -1582 to -3809) and energy drift from ~26 to -292, exceeding allowed 146. Counterfactual with same steps but dt reduced to 0.001 preserves energy, confirming causal role of too-large dt/substep resolution.
